documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 To Be Held On October 29, 2026.

Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, October 23, 2026 - Substitution Of Proposed Allottees And Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 Of D. P. Abhushan Limited

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported total revenue of INR 853.63 crores in Q1 FY27, representing a 58% year-on-year growth supported by strong customer demand during the summer wedding season and festive purchases. EBITDA for the quarter increased by 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.01%, while PAT reached INR 64 crores. The company is executing its store expansion roadmap with finalized showroom locations in Dahod, Gujarat, and Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, aiming to reach a total of 51 stores in the long term. Management internally targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: Management aims to reach a total network of 51 stores, primarily driven by COCO model showrooms.
guidance.quote: our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

guidance.claim: The company internally targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan aims to increase its overall studded category mix to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
guidance.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: The company targets an annual top-line growth rate of approximately 25% to 30% over the next five years until the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates revenue for FY27 and FY28 to be around INR4,800 crores and INR5,500 crores respectively, implying a 20% to 25% growth.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company's EBITDA margin guidance for FY27 is around 6% to 6.5%.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins to reach between 8% and 8.5% by 2030.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: The company expects the online venture to contribute around 3% to 5% of its revenue over the next five years.
guidance.quote: Based on our current plans, we expect this channel to contribute around 3% to 5% of our revenue over the next five years.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold revenue increased 59% year-on-year to INR 781 crores in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Gold revenue increased from INR491 crores in Q1 FY26 to INR781 crores in Q1 FY27. This is reflecting a growth of 59% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver revenue grew 150% year-on-year to INR 40 crores in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver, one of the segments, which is growing drastically, it has grown as compared to Q1 FY26 where we were having INR16 crores to INR40 crores in Q1 FY27, registering a strong growth of 150% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding-related purchases accounted for 62% of sales during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall same-store sales growth for the company stood at 52%.
demand_outlook.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy in Q1 FY27, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange contributed approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding jewellery continues to be the single largest driver of jewellery demand in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Cultural and Wedding-Driven Demand the single largest driver of jewellery demand in India Gold jewellery continues to be viewed as an essential part of marriage rituals, gifts, and long- term savings and security.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs such as daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising gold prices have pushed consumers toward lighter designs. Daily-wear gold, studded jewellery, and minimalist designs are gaining popularity This trend supports higher purchase frequency with lower ticket sizes.

demand_outlook.claim: During FY26, value growth remained strong while overall volume growth declined by around 20%.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand remains intact and is growing as consumers shift away from gold due to high gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver demand remains intact. In fact, with gold prices increasing and impacting demand, we are seeing a shift towards silver.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall customer demand in April and mid-May before Prime Minister's comments showed good growth without pressure on showrooms.
demand_outlook.quote: So, far as April and mid-May, when we look at, this is before PM comment. So, I think the growth was doing good. As such, we did not find any kind of pressure on any of the showroom, and the walk-ins keep on coming.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations have been finalized for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Under this roadmap, we have successfully finalized the locations for new showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, and Dahod, Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahod showroom will measure approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and operate under the COCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market. This showroom will operate under the Company-Owned Company-Operated model.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jabalpur showroom will measure approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and represent the company's first FOCO model store.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores during the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations have been finalized for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new showroom in Dhar, taking its total showroom network to 12.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: For the current year, the company plans to open three to four new COCO stores alongside franchisee additions.
capex_expansion.quote: For this financial year, we are planning to open around three to four COCO stores, along with adding more franchisees in a phased manner.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a long-term goal to reach around 51 stores by 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand its retail footprint into Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned earlier, we are focusing on expansion across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin expanded to 7.55% during Q1 FY27, up 82 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: For full year FY26, EBITDA margins improved to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for full year FY26 improved by 180 basis points over FY25 to 5.20%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR211.8 crores, delivering a robust growth of 88% YoY, with PAT margins improving to 5.20%, an expansion of 180 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 28% to 30% of inventory gains were reflected in the books during FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Approximately 28% to 30% of the inventory gains have been reflected in our books.

orders_capacity.claim: The store footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81% in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

orders_capacity.claim: The total retail store area stood at approximately 53,650 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Average revenue per square foot for FY26 was approximately INR7.6 lakhs, and average revenue per store was approximately INR339 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Inventory turnover for FY26 stood at approximately 4.7x.
orders_capacity.quote: while inventory turnover stood at ~4.7x, highlighting efficient inventory management and faster stock rotation.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall store-level conversion rate remained largely stable at approximately 82% to 83%.
orders_capacity.quote: while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually.
capital_allocation.quote: Our business currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually, which, in our view, is among the best in the industry.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's planned QIP has been put on hold because current market conditions are not favourable.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable. As a result, we have not proceeded with it yet.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: More than 90% to 95% of the company's investment is in inventory, with no immediate need for long-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: If you look at our balance sheet, more than 90% to 95% of our investment is in inventory. So, our capital requirement is largely driven by inventory, and there is no immediate need for long-term funding.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold import duty was increased from 6% to 15% in May 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sharp, short-term increases in gold prices tend to temporarily pause consumer demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: What we have observed over many years in this industry is that whenever gold prices rise sharply in a short period of time, demand tends to pause temporarily.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted recent industry-wide discussion around customs duty changes and the Prime Minister's comments regarding mindful spending practices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Over the past few weeks, there has also been industry-wide discussion around the recent customs duty changes and the Honourable Prime Minister’s comments regarding mindful spending practices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Expansion may be deferred by one or two quarters due to recent government initiatives and market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: That said, some expansion may be deferred by one or two quarters due to the recent initiatives announced by the Honourable Prime Minister. We are closely monitoring the impact before proceeding further.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting the addition of five to six new stores in the current year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase its overall studded category mix to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to build a total footprint of 51 stores.
management_commitments.quote: our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

management_commitments.claim: The management plans to expand its footprint in Gujarat, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open three to four new stores in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching a total of around 51 stores by the end of 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting an entry into Jaipur within the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve an online revenue contribution of 3% to 5% over the next three to five years.
management_commitments.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
